title: Which, That and Whose
theory:
 Which – It is used for things, animals, and ideas (non-human nouns).
   That – It is used for both persons and things.
    Use "that" in case of:
        (a) Superlative degree
        (b) All, everything, nothing, Anything, Something
        (c) The same, the first, the last, the only.
        (d) When a human and a non-human is given.

 Whose: It shows possession over noun.
 Whoever: used to refer to any person who performs an action, without specifying which
  person (acts as the subject of a verb).
 Whomever: used to refer to any person who receives an action, without specifying which
  person (acts as the object of a verb or preposition).
 Whatever: used to refer to anything or any thing, no matter what it is or which one.
